_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Udlala Klondike Solitaire. Inhloso yakho kuyi kutsalisa kekhozi zonke kwenye pile za-foundation.

Imiyalo ye-Mdlalo:
- Pile za-foundation (F1-F4): Akha phezulu kusuka Ace kuya King ngaphansi kwesuti
- Pile za-tableau (T1-T7): Akha phansi ngokuhambisana kwamabala (bomvu phezu kwenye mnyama, mnyama phezu kwenye bomvu)
- Stock: Tsala kekhozi kwenye pile ya-waste
- Waste (W): Ikekhozi e-top iyatholakala kwenye mdlalo

Imiyalo:
- 'draw' - Tsala kekhozi kusuka stock kuya waste
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Tsala kekhozi phakathi kwenye pile
  Imibono: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count inaweza nayo 'all', leyo itakula kutsalisa kekhozi zonke ezibonakalayo.
- 'forfeit' - Qeda umdlalo manje nje na uyasale ngeskoru yakho sikhona
- Amagama a-pile: W (waste), F1-F4 (foundation), T1-T7 (tableau)

Ungakwenza imidlalo eminingi kwenye mizamo moya ngokuhlukanisa ngekoma:
  Umbono: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Kings kuphela angatholakala kwenye pile za-tableau eziphakathi.
Imidlalo iyakwenziwa ngokulandelana - uma eyodwa iqede, imidlalo iliyobaki iyasale.
Sebenzisa 'forfeit' uma ucela ukuthi umdlalo uqedile ukunqoba.

format_error.no_brackets: Ifomethi yesento lesingasebenti. Lesenzo kumele sibe ngekhatsi kwemakhethini (brackets).
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Ifomethi yekwenta lengasebenti. Kulahleka kwebracket yekuvala ']'
format_error.move_needs_args: Umyalo wa-move udinga isikhala na indawo. Sebenzisa: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_invalid: Inombolo siyo ngempela. Sebenzisa inombolo noma 'all'

move_result.cannot_draw: Angeke sikhone kukhipha, kokubili lokusele kanye nalokulahliwe sekuphelile.
move_result.invalid_pile: Ligama le-pile alisebenti. Sebentisa W, F1-F4, nobe T1-T7
move_result.foundation_one_card: Ungakwati kuhambisa likhadi linye kuphela kulesisekelo.
move_result.waste_to_foundation_ok: Likhadi lelisuswe kumlotsa laya esisekelweni F{dst}
move_result.waste_to_foundation_bad: Angeke sikhone kuhambisa likhadi lelisusiwe kulenqwaba yesisekelo.
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_ok: Kharti yalishwa kutoka tableau T{src} ku foundation F{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_bad: Angeke sikhone kuhambisa likhadi le-tableau kuleso sitoko semacembe.
move_result.foundation_to_foundation: Angeke uhambe kusuka kusisekelo kuya kulesinye sisekelo.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_one_card: Ungakwati kuhambisa likhadi linye kuphela kusuka ku-waste kuya kutetayiliti.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_ok: Kusuka ekhadini leligcwele kuya ku-Table T{dst}
move_result.waste_to_tableau_bad: Angeke ufake likhadi lelikhishwe kuleyo ndzawo yekubhala emathayili.
move_result.no_face_up: Kute emakhadi labhalwe ngemehlo lokufanele asuswe.
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_ok: Kharti {count} zilishwa kutoka tableau T{src} ku T{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_bad: Alinaweza kuhamisha {count} kadi(s) kutoka T{src} ku T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_one_card: Ungakwati kuhambisa likhadi linye kuphela kusuka esisekelweni kuya ku-tableau.
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_ok: Kharti yalishwa kutoka foundation F{src} ku tableau T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_bad: Angeke ufake likhadi lesisekelo ku-tableau T{dst}

outcome.turn_limit: Game ikomile! Ufikie kiwango cha juu cha {max_turns} turns. Alama: {score} kadi katika foundation.
